title: 一起理解照護資訊
checks: 只有指定動作與運鏡發生；沒有隨機切鏡
臉部清楚，肢體與接觸自然，背景不閃爍
生成長度、裁切範圍、參考素材標籤與模式一致
prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action photographic realism. The shot begins from <Picture 1>, retaining the exact opening framing, lighting and character arrangement.  Live-action, photographic realism. Use the revised first frame as exact identities, staging, clothes and phone geometry. One uninterrupted 5.167-second candid care discussion, not a group portrait. At the beginning, the patient looks at the phone screen while the nurse watches the same screen. Next, the nurse makes a small explanatory gesture beside the phone without touching or passing through it; the two doctors and husband observe the phone or patient with independent subtle breathing and blinks. Toward the end, patient makes one small thoughtful nod and returns her gaze to the screen; the others remain involved in the discussion, without synchronized head turns. ALL gazes remain on the phone or another person, never at the camera, including the final frame. Neutral attentive expressions throughout: no shared smiling, no grinning or celebratory relief. Solid dark phone back faces camera; screen toward people casts soft white light. Preserve all five people and anatomy, no extras. Preserve facial identity, age, wardrobe and lighting from the supplied visual sources. Initial object positions match the opening reference; only the explicitly described movements may change them. Keep the movement continuous with no cut or pose reset. Natural breathing and cloth motion continue between the specified actions. No subtitles, added graphics or new lettering are generated. People remain silent with lips naturally at rest; there is no dialogue, singing or narration. The full shot lasts 5.167 seconds. Keep one continuous shot, no captions or newly invented lettering.

overall_soundscape: Low consultation-room ventilation and subtle sleeve and paper rustle. Spoken dialogue remains clear and louder than the room sounds, with no public announcements.

non_diegetic_music: A very quiet slow felt-piano pattern with sustained low cello, no singing or percussion. Keep the score below speech, with no sudden swell; leave a gentle held tone at the end.
